app.description: Turn a Guitar Pro tab into an MP4 with a moving playhead. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
app.title: sonotas – Guitar Pro tabs to video
export.done.title: Your video is ready
export.failed.retry: Try again, or turn off Fast export under Output.
export.failed.title: Couldn’t export the video.
export.label: Export
export.unsupported.body: Export needs the WebCodecs video encoder. Open sonotas in a recent Chrome or Edge.
export.unsupported.title: This browser can’t export video.
file.error.title: Couldn’t open that file.
frame.aspect.free.hint: Any size, in px at 1080p. The notation keeps its size; the frame shows more or less of it.
frame.aspect.portrait.hint: Portrait, for Shorts, Reels and TikTok.
frame.at.track.ahead.hint: {n}% across, leaving more of what is coming in view.
frame.bars_per_line.auto.hint: As many bars as fit the width.
frame.bars_per_line.fixed.hint: {n} bars on every line, squeezed or stretched to fit.
frame.fit_bars.hint: {n, plural, one {The notation is sized so one bar spans the width.} other {The notation is sized so # bars span the width.}}
frame.free.hint: Drag the frame's edges in the preview, or type a size. 720p and 480p scale it down.
frame.layout.line.hint: One long line of notation running through the frame.
frame.layout.page.hint: Lines stacked like printed sheet music; the view moves down.
frame.only_bars: {n, plural, one {Show only this bar} other {Show only these # bars}}
frame.playhead.glide.hint: The playhead sweeps through each bar in time.
frame.playhead.jump.hint: The playhead steps from note to note.
frame.run_past: Keep the playhead in place past the song's ends
frame.size.line.hint: Larger notation shows fewer bars at once.
frame.size.page.hint: Larger notation fits fewer bars on each line.
frame.spacing.normal.hint: The spacing alphaTab engraves by default.
frame.spacing.tight.hint: Notes sit close together, so more bars fit.
frame.spacing.wide.hint: Notes spread out, so each bar reads more easily.
frame.steady: Steady speed through busy and sparse passages
frame.transition.cut.hint: The view cuts straight to its new place.
frame.transition.hint: How long the view takes to move over.
frame.transition.track.cut.hint: The view cuts to repeats and jumps.
frame.transition.track.hint: How the view moves over to repeats and jumps.
frame.turn_early.bar: Turn a bar early, so what comes next is in view
frame.turn_early.line: Turn a line early, so what comes next is in view
frame.view.bar.centred.hint: The view moves once per bar, keeping the bars centred.
frame.view.bar.hint: The view moves once per bar.
frame.view.bar.page.hint: The view moves once per line.
frame.view.screen.hint: The view holds still, then turns a whole screen.
frame.view.screen.page.hint: The view holds a screenful of lines, then turns the page.
frame.view.track.hint: The view moves all the time, keeping the playhead in place.
header.link.label: Copy a link to these settings
header.open.label: Open a tab…
header.open.tip: Guitar Pro (.gp, .gpx, .gp3–5) or MusicXML. Or drop a file anywhere. It stays in your browser.
header.reset.label: Reset settings
header.reset.tip: Reset every setting to its default
help.feedback.failed: The feedback form could not be loaded. Try again later.
help.feedback.privacy: Your tab file is not sent.
help.feedback.title: Send feedback
help.how.bars.text: Export the whole song, or only some bars: drag the brackets on the bar strip, or press I and O.
help.how.bars.title: Pick the bars.
help.how.export.text: The MP4 is rendered and muxed right here, and comes back to the stage to watch or save.
help.how.export.title: Export.
help.how.open.text: Guitar Pro (.gp, .gpx, .gp3–5) or MusicXML, picked or dropped anywhere on the page.
help.how.open.title: Open a tab.
help.how.picture.text: Frame, Look and Playhead decide where the score sits and how it is drawn.
help.how.picture.title: Set the picture.
help.how.privacy: Everything runs in your browser. The file you open is never uploaded.
help.how.sound.text: Sound plays the song with a built-in synth: every track, one alone or all but one, with a metronome and a count-in if you like.
help.how.sound.title: Add sound.
help.how.title: How it works
help.keys.arrows: On the bar strip: step a bar back or on. On a bracket: move it a bar
help.keys.ctrl-scroll: On the preview: zoom in to look closer (the export stays as it is). Drag to pan, double-click to fit again
help.keys.home-end: On the bar strip: jump to the start or end
help.keys.in: Start the export at the bar under the playhead
help.keys.out: End the export at the bar under the playhead
help.keys.page: On a bracket: move it four bars
help.keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.keys.zoom: On the bar strip or its overview: zoom in or out. Pinch or Ctrl-scroll over the strip, or drag an end of the overview window
help.news.title: What's new
intro.lead: sonotas turns a Guitar Pro tab into a video with a moving playhead, rendered right in your browser.
intro.sample: This is a sample: press play to see it move, or open your own tab.
link.error.copy: Couldn’t copy the link. It’s in the address bar: {url}
link.notice.skipped: {count, plural, one {One setting in this link couldn’t be used here, perhaps from a newer sonotas. The rest applied.} other {# settings in this link couldn’t be used here, perhaps from a newer sonotas. The rest applied.}}
link.notice.unreadable: The settings in this link couldn’t be read, so the defaults are used.
look.custom_colors.hint: A colour picked here overrides the theme. Staff lines take the notation colour at this strength.
look.rhythm.auto.hint: As the file sets it: under the tab only when the file hides standard notation.
look.show.time_sig: Time signature at the first bar
look.show.title: Song title
look.song_book.hint: Bends, whammy dips and let-ring drawn and played like a printed song book.

output.format.title: Format
output.fps.label: Frames per second

output.timing.title: Timing
playhead.highlight.off: Tints the bar the playhead is in.
playhead.playhead.page: In page layout the playhead always spans the current bar.

preview.zoom.fit.label: Zoom {zoom}%, fit the preview
settings.label: Settings
sound.aids.title: Timing aids

sound.countin.label: Count-in
